notes.title: Battle Train Super Demo, and Kickstarter honors game with "Projects We Love" award!
notes.content:
https://clan.steamstatic.com/images/33210920/1789ce6c168a9437d4183f00c367e41fb51f2690.jpg
Makers of Tower of Guns and Mothergunship's New Game
Did you know Terrible Posture Games has a new project about dueling with exploding trains? 

We've teamed up with Nerd Ninjas to bring you BATTLE TRAIN. 

Lay your tracks out to the enemy base, wrestle control of resources from the enemy, build your train into the ultimate demolition machine, and then launch pure destruction upon your foe!

But don't just take our word for it. 
We're excited to be participating in Steam ːtogcakeːNext Fest, and we have a new SUPER demo out now! It's too big to be called a regular demo and you can give it a try (and wishlist the game) right  HERE! We'd love to know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708950/Battle_Train/

https://clan.steamstatic.com/images/33210920/31d1026d8b737a35128b84aca6faf925b3e2b135.png

Final Week on Kickstarter
That's not all though; we're -also- running our first Kickstarter for the game, fundraising to push an already great game to new levels and build all sorts of wacky ideas we really want to stretch for; cat trains, electric maniac champions, terrible poetry.. we need your help to get all these final extra awesome details into the game. 

We love Battle Train, and Kickstarter seems to agree; they just awarded us with an official "Projects We Love" badge! We're humbled and thrilled. We're in our final week of fund raising for the project--so now is the time to act!

Back us on Kickstarter  HERE!

notes.title: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve Patch #1 is available now!
notes.content:
A new update is available for Invincible Presents: Atom Eve! This patch includes various bug fixes and improvements.


 Fixed an issue that caused text boxes and bubbles to occasionally shrink, causing text to spill out
 Fixed minor visual issues with text bubbles across multiple scenes
 Fixed an issue that could allow multiple instances of the skill tree to be opened
 Fixed an issue that could lock the map if the player clicked on a second map location before the first one loaded
 Fixed an issue that could cause elements of the HUD and icons to flicker when hovering
 Adjusted the size of CRIT text in some languages
 Adjusted the offset for shield effects to prevent possible overlapping of adjacent enemies
 Fixed multiple issues related to missing killing a target during shield break
 Fixed an issue that could prevent the "No Holding Back" achievement from unlocking
 Fixed a softlock caused by trying to go to multiple unintended scenes
 Fixed an issue causing Killcannon's charged attack to have the wrong icon
 Fixed focus issues when using the menu on keyboard and mouse

What is Invincible Presents: Atom Eve?
Invincible Presents: Atom Eve is a visual novel with an original story, turn-based combat, and RPG elements. What that means is this is a game that lets you play as Atom Eve and you can make decisions that affect both Eve’s relationships with her friends and family and how events in the storyline play out. It’s our way to put you in control of your own Atom Eve comic book story.

Experience an original story with striking art directed by Rossi Gifford and creative direction by award-winning writer Jill Murray, and explore the life of Atom Eve in a world filled with beloved characters. Based on the comic book by Robert Kirkman, Cory Walker, and Ryan Ottley.

notes.title: Atom Eve @ NYCC! - Community Update #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've got lots to catch you up on in our second Community Update! There's a Invincible Presents: Atom Eve NYCC panel recap, media outlets got an early peek at the game, and some big release date news!



Invincible Presents: Atom Eve arrives November 14!

We're excited to announce that Invincible Presents: Atom Eve, the first original Invincible game from Skybound Games, is releasing in just a few short weeks! The big day is November 14 -- wishlist the game now on Steam to be notified as soon as it's available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060870



Atom Eve @ New York Comic Con!

We just got back from New York Comic Con where we held a panel dedicated to Invincible Presents: Atom Eve! Members of the development team shared their unique insights in adapting the Invincible universe for the medium and bringing a new perspective to familiar events.

For more, we've got a full write-up of the panel up on Skybound.com!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44402017/18503f4fbf8f0152d668f58bdc28f314f5d0356d.jpg


Media Preview Round-Up!

Media outlets were given the opportunity to go hands-on with a portion of the game ahead of release! Members of the press were able to check out episodes 2 and 3 of the story, giving them insights into our core systems without spoiling too much of what's to come! Here's a few previews to check out:

GamesBeat: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve hands on — step into heroine’s shoes

CBR: HANDS-ON: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve Is Shaping Up to Be the Story the Fan-favorite Superhero Deserves

GamingTrend: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve preview — A superhero landing



Wallpaper Drops!

We've been dropping new wallpapers from Invincible Presents: Atom Eve on @SkyboundGames! You can check out the full collection (so far) on our Steam artwork page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44402017/ddcb27a3ac7da8b14bce859ef6482bf6c3f02c62.png



ICYMI: Invincible Season 2 trailer from NYCC!

Wasn't there something else going on in November...?

Oh, right! Invincible Season 2 begins November 3! In case you missed it, check out the latest trailer from New York Comic Con!

notes.title: It's an Atom Eve world - Community Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the first of our Community Updates for Invincible Presents: Atom Eve, the first original Invincible game from Skybound Games. Through these updates we want to give the community the latest news, showcase exclusive art, provide insights from development, and answer community questions directly here on Steam.


Atom Eve @ San Diego Comic-Con

We revealed our brand new game for the first time to all the Invincible fans who attended the Invincible 20th Anniversary Panel at SDCC on July 21, 2023. Maybe you were there? Watch the trailer below if you missed it!

[previewyoutube=aEprU8gDXKU;full][/previewyoutube]
The same day, the long-anticipated release date for Invincible Season 2 was finally revealed. Yes, Season 2 is coming to Prime Video on November 3... But that wasn’t all!

A Special Episode about Atom Eve’s origin story was also announced, and released the same evening on Prime Video alongside a special screening for SDCC attendees! If you haven’t watched that yet… go ahead and do that. We’ll wait.

[previewyoutube=IQmHQLpUrAo;full][/previewyoutube]
 
About the Game

We’ll have a lot more to show and tell until launch, but we want to answer some common questions we’ve seen in this first Community Update.

What kind of game is this?
Invincible Presents: Atom Eve is a visual novel with an original story, turn-based combat, and RPG elements. What that means is this is a game that lets you play as Atom Eve and you can make decisions that affect both Eve’s relationships with her friends and family and how events in the storyline play out. It’s our way to put you in control of your own Atom Eve comic book story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44402017/e825fc4d83e47cd29fb05e8037c3846e819bf124.png
I’ve seen the Invincible animated series but I haven’t read the comics, does that matter?
You don’t have to have read the comics to fully enjoy the story in this game. If you have read the comics, however, you’ll be able to learn new details about characters from the comics, as well as get more background story on some characters that didn’t get a lot of time to shine in the comics before.

I don’t know anything about Invincible!
That’s fine too! Invincible Presents: Atom Eve works as a standalone game and we don’t presume prior knowledge of all things Invincible for any player. We recommend you watch the series, though! It’s awesome! (But we may be a little biased here...)

Is this game canon to the comics or the animated series?
Because you can choose how the story plays out, the game is not strictly canon to either the comics or the animated series. The characters and the story are authentic to both the comics and animated series, and our dev team works closely with creators of Invincible to ensure everything feels like the Invincible you know and love.

What platform will the game release on?
We’re only planning a release for PC via Steam at this time.
 
That’s great, I’m reading this on Steam anyway! But when can I play it??
Expect to play Invincible Presents: Atom Eve later this year! We know, we know… you had to wait for a Season 2 release date for a while. But we’ll share the release date as soon as we have one to share!


What’s next? Tell us what you want to know! We love to hear from our fans, and make sure to Follow the game on the Store page so that you get future updates like these sent directly to your Steam News Hub!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060870
